# --- Bota force/torque (PyPI; the driver wheel is abi3 cp312) ---
# Bota Control Toolkit generation A (Nov-2025 demo line). The estimator/compensator
# API changed from the old 0.0.2: there is no longer a create_ft_sensor_hwi() wrapper;
# the caller assembles the 12-vector (raw wrench + IMU-in-sensor-frame via bota_tf_utils
# .BotaTfImu) and passes it to estimator.update(ts, w12) / compensator.update(ts, raw12,
# comp12). The underlying EKF is unchanged (numerically identical compensation). update()
# returns a bota_control.BotaControlReturnCode ENUM (always truthy — compare to .OK,
# never `if not update()`). The estimator still hardcodes enable_dynamic_compensation
# in the file it writes (1.0.2 -> false), so force_torque/*.py force it true after.
bota-driver==1.1.9
bota-payload-utils==1.0.2
bota-control==1.0.4
bota-tf-utils==1.0.12

# --- gripper (vendored i2rt subset on PYTHONPATH needs these at runtime) ---
python-can==4.5.0
pydantic==2.13.4
click<8.2.0
packaging==26.0

# --- keyboard -> gripper evdev bridge ---
evdev==1.9.3
